text:
kevin: Quick heads-up — planning a terraform apply in the 14:00-14:30 UTC release window. This is an IAM role change + route-table update for customer-tenant isolation. Deploybot scheduled at 14:05 UTC. Need agreement on version pin and rollback signal flow.

maria: Thanks — which modules are we pinning? also who will own the rollback?

kevin: Pinning okta-provider module to v2.3.1 and network-routing module to v1.9.0. Rollback owner: jamal on-call, claire backup.

jamal: Ok I can take rollback. Put me on the urgent page and add a runbook pointer.

claire: +1. Can we do a dry-run first? last time route changes caused ephemeral failures.

kevin: yes — will run a dry-run at 13:45 UTC and share plan. If dry-run looks good, proceed with deploybot at 14:05.

deploybot: Deploybot scheduled: terraform apply -auto-approve at 14:05 UTC (triggered by kevin). Dry-run requested: terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan run at 13:45 UTC. Reaction: :robot_face:

jamal: copy. what's the rollback signal? I want a clear abort rule.

kevin: Rollback signal: any 5xx spike > 2% p90 lat increase on infra routes OR if auth failures > 0.5% of requests for >5m. Post "ROLLBACK NOW" in this thread and tag @jamal.

maria: I'll update release notes and include the pin info and the test checklist. link: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/2026-03-21 (WIP)

claire: Sharing quick checklist: 
- run plan (13:45)
- confirm no drift in IAM bindings
- canary route shift to one AZ (14:05)
- watch 10m
- escalate rollback if metrics breach

kevin: plan output (excerpt):
```
# terraform plan
+ resource "aws_iam_role" "tenant_bridge" {
  name = "redwood-tenant-bridge-v2"
}
~ resource "aws_route_table" "tenant_rt" {
  routes = ["10.0.0.0/16 -> igw-xxxx"]
}
```

alex: noted the plan. I validated that the module version pins are compatible with current state: `module.okta = v2.3.1`, `module.network = v1.9.0`. No provider upgrades required.

sre-bot: Monitoring alerting policy attached: infra/route-latency, infra/auth-errors. Pager duty escalation: primary -> jamal -> claire.

kevin: After dry-run I'll post the full plan file and a short TL;DR in this thread. If everyone is good, we proceed. :thumbsup:

maria: Good to go from product docs side. I'll attach release note blurb after dry-run.

jamal: I'll be standing by. If I see the signal I'll post "ROLLBACK NOW" and run `rollback-playbook.sh` (step 1: revert module pins to previous versions, step 2: drain affected AZ).

claire: thumbs up. small ask — if deploybot fails mid-apply, follow automated unwind and notify here.

deploybot: Noted: on failure will attempt graceful unwind and post status. Manual takeover requires `deploybot override --force`.

kevin: Thanks all — will run dry-run at 13:45 and update thread.
